senses.gloss: m.(b. h.; v. חָפַף II) rubbed off, bare, esp. bare-footed, foot-sore.
units: <cite ref="Jerusalem Talmud Sanhedrin 10:2:5">Y. Snh. X, 28ᵇ</cite> bot (expl. <he>אט</he> <cite ref="I Kings 21:27">I Kings XXI, 27</cite>) <he>היה מהלך י׳</he> he walked bare-footed (in penance); <cite ref="Shir HaShirim Rabbah 1:5:2">Cant. R. to I, 5</cite>.—

<cite ref="Yoma 77a:12">Yoma 77ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="II Samuel 15:30">II Sam. XV, 30</cite>) <he>י׳ ממאי וכ׳</he> ‘bare’ of what?—Does it not mean bare of sandals?; v. <cite ref="M01070"><he>מְטַרְקָא</he></cite>.—

<cite ref="Shabbat 114a:4">Sabb. 114ᵃ</cite> (ref. to <cite ref="Isaiah 20:3">Is. XX, 3</cite>) <he>י׳ במנעלים וכ׳</he> ‘bare’ means in patched shoes; a. fr.—Pl. <he>יְחֵפִים</he>, <he>יְחֵפִין</he>, <he>יְחֵי׳</he>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 5:8">Num. R. s. 5</cite>; a. fr.—Fem. <cite ref="J00291"><he>יְחֵפָה</he></cite>, <he>יְחֵי׳</he>. Ruth. R. to I, 19; a. e.—Pl. <he>יְחֵיפוֹת</he>.
<cite ref="Yalkut Shimoni on Nach 601:3">Yalk. Ruth 601</cite> (<cite ref="Ruth Rabbah 2:12">Ruth R. to I, 7</cite> <he>ביַיחַף</he>); a. e.
